_readme: Second read of Los Angeles Harbor College's maps (S345, SkyLantern). Read 1 (run 37810652946): the college's Program Mapper page answers and says each program shows 'a term-by-term sample map'; la-harbor.programmapper.com answered 403 (the mapper service's refusal, not retried). The page also links the college's own Program Mapper Programs page (www.lahc.edu/academics/programs). This read loads that page and prints any map, sequence or PDF it links.

questions.map_source: Whether the college's own pages publish a program's term-by-term map anywhere outside the refused mapper.
